about: Inputs the essay's exhibits read that are not graded rows: the frozen JSON summaries of the training experiments (Part 3) and the code literals some charts draw. Each entry names its lab source path, the commit that last changed it, and (for files) its sha256.
extracted_by: the lab's export_graded_rows extraction (lab-side; reads the private lab tree)

data.recipe: median over 1,098 held-out responses of max(0, output_token_count - tokens of the last confidence line and the final answer line), per checkpoint; mean over seeds 0 to 2; mean over Qwen3 8B and Nemotron 3 Nano 30B (essay_effort.py)

students_2A.note: Hypothetical students; the chart draws the first two rows.

benchmark_names.where: the Summary copy of [1.B], data-bench, easiest first

payoff_2C.where: tbl-ev-true: the chance row and the report headers

attempt_panels.item: v6.70 item P14 (panel 3: "Some right, some wrong" to "Four of eight right")
attempt_panels.where: fig-noreason-attempts panel heads, in page order

cause_source.rule: cause from each model's recorded status

roster_exclusion_reasons.item: v6.71 item 35003 (R48(i)): each left-out model's reason opens with its recorded cause (usability check, provider failure on its OpenRouter route, or unfinished at the freeze), traced per model in R53/R48 part B
roster_exclusion_reasons.where: tbl-developers, each developer's "Not included" list; each sentence opens with its cause's label and quotes the model's own count
